name: City of Phoenix Civil Water And Sewer Completion And Acceptance Requirements
known_limitations: The page identifies City approval-to-construct, certificate-of-completion, and civil water and sewer acceptance materials. It does not show that the TSMC conveyance improvements were submitted, built, inspected, accepted, placed in service, or performing as designed.
source_owner: City of Phoenix Planning and Development Department
automation_notes: Use the listed approval, completion, and acceptance artifacts to name the downstream evidence stage. Continue to project-specific records before asserting construction or operation.
notes: Phase 55Q procedural source. The page defines the municipal artifact family needed to move the TSMC wastewater agreement from authorization into constructed and accepted infrastructure.
